findings.finding: The published Bailey & Lopez de Prado (2012) MinTRL closed form and the previously implemented estimator are different identities; the plan now declares which one it means and the closed form is cross-checked against the published expression, not against a stored constant.

The non-normality term is evaluated at the OBSERVED Sharpe and the gap at (observed - benchmark). The memo's section 4.1 renders SR* in both places; the implemented convention is the one carried by the published expression and by independent implementations, and the discrimination is pinned by a test where the two conventions give different integers.

measure_capacity documented a sequencing/single-instrument contract it never enforced, and published a counterfactual participation beside observed-scale fill/impact (the linear extrapolation the memo lists as REJECTED_OPTION). Both are now guarded.

The measured part of #382 stays DATA_BLOCKED on real tape: the captured depth tapes are 20-level REST snapshots polled every ~3.3s (52/72/117 files), not event-sequenced top-of-book updates, and none of the 297 tape files carries fill fields. No impact coefficient is estimated or invented.
A venue-cost receipt without (venue, tier, effective date) collapses venue heterogeneity; maker and taker fills now calibrate separately.
price_pnl_already_net_of_friction was the only guard against a spread double-count and was caller-declared with no evidence; it now requires a verified ArtifactBinding or the ledger fails closed.
